visualCharacteristics.purpose: closing banner with photo background, dark overlay, heading, text and CTA
visualCharacteristics.description: Photo background with overlay, heading, text and CTA. The photo belongs to the block, so the section is not styled despite the black band.

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image; row 2: heading, paragraph and CTA link

usage: Full-width promotional or closing banners on a photo.
reuseGuidance: The photo belongs to the block; do not use a section background image for this pattern. Adds no-image when the image is missing.
